scripts.dev:docs: pnpm run bundle && concurrently "pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build:watch" "pnpm --filter docs run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test:dist
scripts.check: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run lint && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test:types && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run check:package
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run build && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test:watch
scripts.release:alpha: pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart run test && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart version prerelease --preid alpha && pnpm --filter use-shopping-cart publish --tag alpha
